जृभ् 1. A. जर्भे hiare, aperire, expandere, os diducere, oscitare;
v. sq. et cf. जभ्, जम्भ्. (Germ. vet. CHLUP
findere, chliupu findo, attenuato अ τοῦ जर्भ् in u; germ.
med. KLUB hiare, separari; transfindere; nostrum klaffe,
Kluft; huc etiam traxerim goth. graba fodio, nostrum
grabe, gr. γϱάϕω; hib. grabhaim «I carve, grave, insculp»,
